events.title: Dino Trivia!
events.description: Test your geologic and dinosaur knowledge at our Dino Trivia event, where every question celebrates your love of all things Jurassic (and beyond)! From T-Rex to Neanderthals, pop-culture to scientific fact, enjoy a friendly afternoon competition and dino-mite company! Ages 6+. Registration suggested, but walk-ins are welcome!

events.title: Fairfax County Summer Carnival and Fair (Friday)
events.description: The 76th Fairfax County 4-H Fair at Frying Pan Farm Park: carnival games and rides, tractor demos, 4-H exhibits and shows, farm animals and fair food. Admission is free; parking is $10 Friday through Sunday. Unlimited-ride wristbands are sold separately.
events.sourceName: Fairfax County Summer Carnival and Fair (Friday)

events.title: Dinosaur Trivia!
events.description: Can't get enough of dinosaurs? Come to Kingstowne Library to put your knowledge to the test in an afternoon game of trivia and win prizes! Ages 7-10. Please only register your child for this event.
